newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends shade down on producer sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends shade down on producer sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended a shade lower on Thursday from the previous New York close on light producer selling, bullion traders said.
Bullion ended at US$344.90/345.40 an ounce Thursday against New York's US$345.00/50 close on Wednesday.
News that China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping died late on Wednesday did not affect the bullion markets, traders said.
Producer sales in the morning pushed gold lower, but prices recovered slightly in afternoon shortcovering, gold sources said.
Physical demand provided firm support to prices, traders noted.
Market activity remained quiet and gold continued to trade within a narrow range.
Local gold ended HK$13 lower at HK$3,191 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to nil from its previous fix at -4.90.
Hong Kong close - US$344.90/345.40 New York close - US$345.00/50
